acceptance_gate: Verified returned circuits and exact global minimum for all saved edits, same raw histories, offline coverage reproduced, and measured checking once per usable proof.
completion_gate: Report charged original discovery, misses, accepted exclusions, exact fallback and net CPU, a paid ideal-selector bound and any triggered fresh training experiment.
objective: Reproduce shared pair-proof coverage and price complete exact search, proof discovery and checking on the saved parent edits. Measure attainable additional savings from choice of pair and setting before fitting a local chooser on fresh tasks.
status: One checked pair certificate rules out many triples. Coverage reproduced at 2,099/2,100 fresh and 1,818/2,100 reused. The ideal chooser won 7/8 saved two-bit timings. On 72 new verified edits a frozen two-step policy returned all exact minima, avoided 741/3,084 alternative tests, and never repaid training; median paired total gaps 4.504s two-bit and 4.508s mixed. Closed the paid learned-choice direction for this family.
stop_rule: Stop after fixed/advised cost comparison if the best actionable choice has no reproducible deployable headroom. If it passes, train, freeze, and price the learner on new larger structures.
title: Can one checked signal pair rule out many one-bit summaries after a circuit edit?
